_README: Demo text for puja-live (replace with your own). See docs/DATA-FORMAT.md. Each line: bo (Tibetan), tr (English phonetics), en (English translation), trz (Chinese phonetics), zh (Chinese translation); empty strings are not shown. v = verse number. before/after = ritual instructions. tara = figure shown on the Live card for this verse. Sections: anytime, card, loop, reveal, parts, group, taras.

mantra.trz: 嗡 大列 都大列 都列 梭哈

lines.tr: sangyé chö dang tsok kyi chok nam la
lines.en: In the Buddha, the Dharma and the supreme Assembly
lines.trz: 桑傑 確當 措吉 確南拉

lines.tr: jangchub bardu dak ni kyab su chi
lines.en: I take refuge until I reach awakening.
lines.trz: 蔣秋 巴都 達尼 嘉蘇齊

lines.tr: dak gi jin sok gyipé sönam kyi
lines.en: Through the merit of generosity and the other virtues I practise,
lines.trz: 達基 進索 吉貝 索南吉

lines.tr: dro la pen chir sangyé drub par shok
lines.en: may I attain buddhahood for the benefit of all beings.
lines.trz: 卓拉 片企 桑傑 竹巴秀

lines.tr: semchen tamché dewa dang dewé gyu dang denpar gyur chik
lines.en: May all beings have happiness and the causes of happiness.
lines.zh: 願一切有情具樂及樂因

lines.tr: semchen tamché dukngal dang dukngal gyi gyu dang dralwar gyur chik
lines.en: May all beings be free from suffering and the causes of suffering.
lines.zh: 願一切有情離苦及苦因

lines.tr: semchen tamché dukngal mepé dewa dampa dang mi dralwar gyur chik
lines.en: May all beings never be separated from the sacred happiness free of suffering.
lines.zh: 願一切有情不離無苦之妙樂

lines.tr: semchen tamché nyé ring chak dang nyi dang dralwé tang nyom tsé mepa la népar gyur chik
lines.en: May all beings rest in boundless equanimity, free from attachment to near and aversion to far.
lines.zh: 願一切有情遠離親疏愛憎住平等捨

lines.tr: om jetsün ma pakma drolma la chak tsal lo
lines.en: Om. Homage to the noble Lady Tārā.

lines.tr: chak tsal drolma nyurma pamo
lines.en: Homage to Tārā, swift and fearless, whose eyes flash like lightning, born from the opening heart of the lotus face of the Protector of the Three Worlds.

lines.tr: chen ni kéchik lok dang drama
lines.en: Homage to Tārā, swift and fearless, whose eyes flash like lightning, born from the opening heart of the lotus face of the Protector of the Three Worlds.

lines.tr: jikten sum gön chukyé zhal gyi
lines.en: Homage to Tārā, swift and fearless, whose eyes flash like lightning, born from the opening heart of the lotus face of the Protector of the Three Worlds.

lines.tr: gésar jéwa lé ni jungma
lines.en: Homage to Tārā, swift and fearless, whose eyes flash like lightning, born from the opening heart of the lotus face of the Protector of the Three Worlds.

lines.tr: chak tsal tönkay dawa küntu
lines.en: Homage to you whose face is a hundred full autumn moons gathered together, blazing with the light of a thousand assembled stars.

lines.tr: gangwa gya ni tsekpé zhal ma
lines.en: Homage to you whose face is a hundred full autumn moons gathered together, blazing with the light of a thousand assembled stars.

lines.tr: karma tongtrak tsokpa nam kyi
lines.en: Homage to you whose face is a hundred full autumn moons gathered together, blazing with the light of a thousand assembled stars.

lines.tr: raptu chewé ö rab barma
lines.en: Homage to you whose face is a hundred full autumn moons gathered together, blazing with the light of a thousand assembled stars.

lines.tr: chak tsal ser ngo chu né kyé kyi
lines.en: Homage to you whose hand is adorned with a golden-blue lotus born from water, whose sphere is generosity, effort, austerity, peace, patience and meditation.

lines.tr: pemé chak ni nampar gyen ma
lines.en: Homage to you whose hand is adorned with a golden-blue lotus born from water, whose sphere is generosity, effort, austerity, peace, patience and meditation.

lines.tr: jinpa tsöndrü katub zhiwa
lines.en: Homage to you whose hand is adorned with a golden-blue lotus born from water, whose sphere is generosity, effort, austerity, peace, patience and meditation.

lines.tr: zöpa samten chöyul nyi ma
lines.en: Homage to you whose hand is adorned with a golden-blue lotus born from water, whose sphere is generosity, effort, austerity, peace, patience and meditation.

lines.tr: om taré tuttaré turé soha
lines.trz: 嗡 大列 都大列 都列 梭哈

before.en: Recite the mantra as many times as you can.

lines.tr: gewa di yi kyewo kün
lines.en: By this virtue may all beings

lines.tr: sönam yeshé tsok dzok shing
lines.en: complete the accumulations of merit and wisdom,

lines.tr: sönam yeshé lé jungwé
lines.en: and attain the two sacred kāyas

lines.tr: dampa ku nyi tobpar shok
lines.en: that arise from merit and wisdom.

lines.tr: lama la kyab su chi o
lines.en: I take refuge in the guru.
